question: In 2016, who became the second woman Prime Minister of Great Britain?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Theresa May.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **In July 2016,** after David Cameron resigned, **Theresa May** was elected Conservative Party leader and became the **UK's second female prime minister.**
 
• She is the **first and, to date, the only woman to hold two of the Great Offices of State.**
 
• She also served as a **councillor for Durnsford in ****Merton.**
 
• she was elected as the **MP for Maidenhead in 1997.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f5803dab3d929a7017304c433b82e17eb06a2e35da46bdd799638629f97b6094.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Iron Lady" **is the nickname of **Margaret Thatcher (1925–2013),** the first female prime minister of the United Kingdom.​ 
 
• **Melania Germanized** is a Slovene-American** former model and businesswoman** who served as **First Lady of the United States from 2017 to 2021, as the wife of 45th President Donald Trump.**
 
• **Angela Dorothea Merkel **is a retired German politician and scientist who served as the chancellor of Germany from** 2005 to 2021.**
